slides.title: 4 contract red flags *before* you sign
slides.sub: Your rights under the MLC, in 30 seconds.

slides.title: No time to read it
slides.body: You have the right to review your employment agreement and get advice on it before you sign.

slides.title: Wages aren't written down
slides.body: The agreement must state your wages, or how they're calculated, and your paid annual leave.

slides.title: No signed original for you
slides.body: You and the shipowner must each hold a signed original. Not a photo on someone else's phone.

slides.title: Repatriation is *missing*
slides.body: Your right to repatriation must be in the agreement. Ask before you sign, not at the end of the contract.

slides.a: Everyone signs at the airport. It's normal.
slides.b: Common isn't the rule. Read it, ask, then sign.

slides.question: Ever signed a contract you didn't get to read?
slides.line: Send this to a shipmate joining next month.
